notes.title: NBB.EXE RE : FINAL EPILOGUE
notes.content:
Due to unexpected data surges, Neon industries and Future corp. have opened previously inaccessible areas of THE SYSTEM for experienced bombers to enjoy. These sections provide [b]extra challenging[/b] sequences and can be accessed through specific gateways, given specific circumstances. 

With this update:

[list]
[*] New locations and shortcuts.
[*] New secrets and revelations in the depths of the machine.
[*] 8 new end game puzzles.
[*] A new achievement.
[*] Adjusted location of a few key NPCs
[*] General fixes and improvements.
[/list]

Do keep in mind that there are several changes in this patch. So if users come across anomalous behavior, we ask you to please inform your nearest NEON INDUSTRIES representative.

[*] Optimized UNDERGROUND and DEVELOPMENT locations further to improve the loading stutter.
[/list]

I am hard at work on the final chapter of the game: [b]Final Epilogue: A lost connection/HOST::NaN[/b]

Stay bombin'

notes.title: Ver 1.32a OCTOBER 26th Big bug fix.
notes.content:
[h1]In this stupendous update:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added ability to HOLD bomb button to automatically PUSH placed bombs.
[*] Finally fixed issue where death didn't return the camera to the character. (REJOICE)
[*] Fixed several collision issues.
[*] Prevented some unintended sequence breaks (don't worry, most sequence breaks are still available).
[*] Adjusted some collisions to better represent the geometry of some objects.
[*] Fixed character being unable to bomb or jump after some dialogue sequences.
[*] Fixed some dialogue triggers that didn't match the placement.
[*] Added colliders to prevent players falling through the world in some locations.
[*] Added and fixed some map information to help players track completion.
[*] Corrected animation blending for some animations of the unlockable characters.
[*] Fixed NPC that would not save its dialogue state.
[*] Fixed right analog stick Input in certain conditions when dashing.
[*] Fixed issue in NG+ that prevented access to some collectibles.
[*] Removed the RECOVERY ROLL exploit that allowed players to bypass some obstacles by rolling (it was very cool, but we all have to git-gud).
[*] Fixed issue where restarting the level after beating it would result in the player being stuck in their celebration pose.
[/list]

Special thanks to our community members, especially [b]SALADMAISTER[/b] for all their bug submissions.

Chief Overthinking Officer.
Bernardo

notes.title: NBB.exe v1.3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome back to The System![/b][/h1]
In the 1.3 update you'll find a number of additions to NBB.exe:

[list]
[*] New height sensor to aid players with the readability of some levels.
[*] Added new height pointer to show vertical position more clearly.
[*] Added information on the tutorial for a better understanding of the mechanics.
[*] Improved shader pre-compilation and texture loading to speed up the initial loading of the game.
[*] Added minor puzzles and shortcuts to create a more cohesive progression in game.
[*] Corrected issues in some HDR screens.
[*] Completely revamped GUI input system to solve the issue of non-responsive and menus (such as settings).
[/list]

Neon industries hopes you'll find these improvements beneficial to your experience.
But if you find any inconveniences, don't hesitate to contact us.

[b]Bernardo[/b]
Head of Recreational Distress.

notes.title: NBB.exe ver1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Humans![/h1]

Today is a significant occasion, for the first [i]big[/i] patch for NBB.exe is here!
What is included, you ask?

[list]
[*] New npcs and dialogues.
[*] New [b]Versus mode[/b] available from the Main menu.

notes.title: NBB.exe is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Neon industries and Raptus games are proud to announce the release of the highly awaited NBB.exe software suite. [/h1]

For real though, after almost a decade of solo development, you can experience my completely unreasonably massive undertaking firsthand!
Please let me know if you find any issues or bugs. My bandwidth is limited but I will try to solve any problems players may encounter.

And if you like the game, review it, comment and [b]let other people know[/b]! Small games like these often live and die on word of mouth.

[b]Thanks for everything![/b]

Bernardo - Neon industries 
Head of Hermeneutics.

notes.title: Final release Patch.
notes.content:
In this update.

[*] New settings adjustments: Bloom, Antialiasing & Ambient Occlusion.
[*] Lowered default Bloom and Chromatic Aberration.
[*] Fixed issue that prevented character emotes from displaying.
[*] Adjusted CHECKPOINT animation to be less aggressive.
[*] Adjusted character pointer for clarity.
[*] Added some environmental props that were not displaying.
[*] Adjusted ending.
[*] Minor fix for visual glitches.
[*] Added new songs and SFX to npc dialogues.
[*] General optimizations and UI corrections that should allow the game to run on the [b]STEAMDECK[/b].

[/list]

Please report any issues you may find and I'll get to fixing them as soon as possible.
